vulnerabilityAlerts.description: A fix for a known vulnerability does not wait for the nightly window. Once Renovate runs, GitHub's 'Dependabot security updates' setting is switched off so one tool raises the pull request rather than two; the alerts themselves stay on — they are what this reads.

packageRules.description: Patch, pin and digest updates merge themselves once the required checks pass (main is protected). Everything else waits for a person.
uv is pinned in website/Dockerfile (COPY --from=ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv) and in every workflow. They move in ONE pull request; tests/test_build_pins.py fails if they disagree.

Python is written in website/Dockerfile, every workflow's setup-python and pyproject's requires-python. One pull request, never auto-merged for a version bump (minor/major) — a runtime bump is a release decision. Digest-only refreshes of the same tag are a different update type and fall through to the general digest rule above, so they still auto-merge.
GitHub Actions, pinned to commit digests.
Base images are pinned by digest; Renovate keeps the digest current (digest updates auto-merge like patches).

customManagers.description: uv installed with pip in the workflows. The website/Dockerfile copy is found by the dockerfile manager; tests/test_build_pins.py keeps both equal.
Tools the workflows run with uvx at a pinned version (codespell, zizmor).

The Python version in setup-python steps and pyproject's requires-python floor. Two components, so docker versioning: under npm versioning a truncated version yields an empty candidate set and the pin is silently left behind (easywall found this the hard way).

The axe-core build the accessibility tests inject. A floating version would change what 'accessible' means between two CI runs. The PR stays red until scripts/vendor_axe.py writes the file and its hash.

The draw.io CLI image scripts/render_diagrams.py exports with, tag and digest on one line. A bump changes every diagram stamp, so the PR stays red until scripts/render_diagrams.py re-renders. The regex manager's default versioning (semver-coerced) reads the v prefix.
